plugins.description: Scale-adaptive agent team for building any project: brief to PRD to architecture to plan to TDD to review to a verified ship. Gates are enforced by hooks and escalate with what the change touches, reports carry the command that reproduces every claim, and work is delegated to subagents so the main context stays small.
